exclusion_reason: This is the only heldout task whose arm measurements straddle the Sep-2 versus Sep-7 provider-era boundary; exclusion is based only on execution timing, not outcomes.
non_rescue_rule: The 17-task sensitivity may veto or downgrade a primary PASS but can never convert a primary FAIL into PASS and can never select a different arm based on favorable sensitivity results.
primary_rule: Use the original 18-task screen exactly as frozen: arm - G0 >= 1/18; select the simplest passing arm G1 < G2 < G3.
sensitivity_rule: If the 18-task primary screen passes, compute candidate minus G0 on the 17 provider-era-matched tasks. Require this difference to be strictly positive before any S2 stability remeasurement authority is considered.
trigger: External weekly-quota interruption split one heldout task across provider eras after 45/72 measurements, while all partial scientific scores remained embargoed.
